description.value: Everest Indian & Nepalese Restaurant is a licensed fine-dining establishment in West Kelowna run by owner-chef Ram Sapkota, who trained across Europe before bringing 30 years of culinary passion to the Okanagan. The menu spans authentic Indian and Nepalese cuisine — from tandoori specialties and Nepalese set meals to an extensive vegetarian and vegan selection — and the restaurant has earned 200+ five-star Google reviews. Catering and event services are also available, and the kitchen is nut-free with dishes prepared across six heat levels.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, licensed fine-dining Indian and Nepalese restaurant at 1–2430 Main Street, West Kelowna, offering dine-in, takeout, and its own delivery service. Vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed by a dedicated menu section and a quoted customer review; gluten-free soups and salads are noted on the menu page. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content; the OSM tags likewise carry no such attributes.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Kelowna' but the website consistently identifies the location as 'West Kelowna, BC' — these are separate municipalities; the OSM record should be corrected.
OSM name is 'Everest' but the business trades as 'Everest Indian Restaurant' / 'Everest Indian & Nepalese Restaurant'.
